UrlCategory.description:
Category identifiers:
 * `0` - Unknown URL category
 * `1` - Either the URL is missing from the database, or it is known to be clean
 * `2` - Malware
 * `3` - Phishing
 * `4` - Spam
 * `5` - Potentially Unwanted Application / Web page containing PUAs
 * `6` - Potentially Unwanted Search Engine
 * `7` - Scam

items.description:
Scam subcategory identifiers:
 * `1` B2B scam
 * `2` Chargeback money recovery scam
 * `3` Cryptocurrency scam
 * `4` Dating and romance scam
 * `5` Employment scam
 * `6` Fake IT and tech support scam
 * `7` Illegal products and services scam
 * `8` Intellectual property violation scam
 * `9` Investment scam
 * `10` Malware scam
 * `11` Online shopping scam
 * `12` Phishing scam
 * `13` Fake website scam
 * `14` Spam and abuse scam
 * `15` Subscription scam
 * `16` Other scam

UrlCheckStatus.description:
Codes:
 * `0` - Check performed successfully
 * `1` - URL check failed. URL is either malformed or an unknown error has occurred
 * `2` - Check is pending in backend, repeat a request for this url later

pe_extensions.description: Files ending with these extensions are portable executables and can be uploaded if asked

non_pe_extensions.description: Files ending with these extensions are non portable executables

deep_scan_types.description: Files with these MIME types should be checked with deep scan, similar to PE extensions

scan_types.description: Files with these MIME types should be checked with regular scan, similar to non-PE extensions

FileCategory.description:
Codes:
 * `0` - File was not found in malware database
 * `1` - File is clean
 * `2` - File is infected with malware

FileCheckStatus.description:
Codes:
 * `0` - OK, Check performed successfully
 * `1` - An unknown error has occurred, file check failed
 * `2` - Check is pending in backend, repeat a request for this file after TTL number of seconds
 * `3` - File is not found, upload is required for further inspection
